html:
SMTO-EXE-0200 — SMTO couldn't set up this PDF request correctly

GUID: 7f10b73c-bc24-553d-8a59-4b68e07826c3
Slug: pdf-invalid-request
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • The PDF action SMTO tried to run was set up in a way the PDF tool doesn't accept, so nothing ran. Your files were not changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If the result will be several files (splitting a PDF, or images of several pages), don't give one file name to save to. Let SMTO save them for this run. One file name can't hold several results, so the request is refused.
  2. If you only want the text from a scanned PDF, don't ask for an output file name. Reading text alone creates no file, so a save name makes the request invalid.
  3. Ask for one PDF action per message, for example "extract pages 2 to 4 of report.pdf into a new PDF". A clear single action is easier for SMTO to set up within the PDF tool's rules.
  4. If you recently renamed or re-added the Gateway, open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check connection for it. The request is refused if it was addressed to a different Gateway name than the computer reports.

What success looks like

  • SMTO runs the PDF action and shows its result, or new files under Artifacts from this run.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the message you sent SMTO, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The PDF request was rejected before processing: unknown operation, arguments failing the operation schema, a node name that does not match the Gateway, or a single output path/filename combined with multiple or no file outputs.

What this means

  • PDF admission rejected an unknown/invalid typed operation, wrong Gateway node or a single explicit output_path combined with multiple generated outputs. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • PDF admission rejected an unknown/invalid typed operation, wrong Gateway node or a single explicit output_path combined with multiple generated outputs.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare schema, selected node, page arguments and single-file versus artifact-bundle output requirements.

How to fix it

  • Check the failing call against gateway_core/pdf/contract.py SPECS: arguments must match the operation schema, output_path and filename are mutually exclusive, OCR in text mode takes neither, and output_path is only valid when exactly one output is produced (omit it for split or multi-page render so outputs go to the run's artifact workspace). Also confirm request.node equals the Gateway's configured node_name.
  • Correct the specific schema, node or output arrangement; use artifact scope when the operation produces multiple files.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect the bounded PDF receipt and input, reduce the request if needed, and retry only after resolving the reported condition.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended typed request validates for the exact target and output form.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
